atoms.text: St. Basil’s Cathedral is a cathedral in Moscow, Russia. It is nearly 500 years old. Ivan the 4th, also known as Ivan the Terrible, had the cathedral built, and it was finished in 1561. Ivan the Terrible was the Grand Prince of Russia and the first Russian Tsar. Tsar is a Russian word which means ruler.

atoms.text: St. Basil’s Cathedral is actually not just one building, but has 9 smaller churches inside. The cathedral is named after Basil the Blessed, who was a Russian saint. St. Basil was said to have healing powers and be able to see into the future. St. Basil’s Cathedral is very beautiful on the inside as well as the outside. The walls are very colourful and decorated in gold. It is one of the most famous landmarks in Russia and a very popular place for tourists to visit.
